answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, because the nebula embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the prism index is rebuilt each epoch, the jetty audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 92% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
